title: Encoding strategies for quantum enhanced fluid simulations: opportunities and challenges
summary: Quantum computing has emerged as a powerful potential accelerator for computational fluid dynamics (CFD), but whether this promise can be realized in practice depends on how fluid information is encoded on quantum hardware. This review provides an architecture-agnostic assessment of encoding strategies for quantum-enhanced fluid simulation, focusing on the trade-offs they impose on state preparation, measurement, boundary treatment, nonlinear dynamics, and temporal evolution.
